answer.summary: The app container crashed on startup because of a duplicate Flyway migration version (V6_20261121140000000__Coverage_scenario_safe_mode_and_approval). The change added this migration, so the duplicate comes from the change and will repeat on every re-run.

evidence.quote: Caused by: java.lang.IllegalStateException: Duplicate Flyway migration version found: V6_20261121140000000__Coverage_scenario_safe_mode_and_approval.class
